import GroupApproximation.Dynamics.TransientIdealExact
import GroupApproximation.Dynamics.ClopenDefectPair
import GroupApproximation.Dynamics.ChainRecurrenceCovering
import GroupApproximation.Meta.AxiomGuard
import Mathlib.RingTheory.TwoSidedIdeal.Operations
import Mathlib.RingTheory.TwoSidedIdeal.BigOperators

/-!
# The transient ideal is generated by the defects

`non_mf_groups_exist.tex`, `lem:transient-matrices`, tex 1476–1487:

> The ideal $I$ is locally matricial and is generated by the indicators $1_{P\setminus T(P)}$ of the
> defects in Lemma~\ref{lem:chain-core-models}.
>
> [...]  The translates of the defects cover that complement; a finite clopen subdivision
> subordinate to this cover on each compact coefficient support proves the ideal-generation claim.

This module proves the generation clause.  The locally matricial clause is a separate lane.

* `compressedDefectSet T k`: the defects `d = 1_{P∖T(P)}`, `P` clopen with `T(P) ⊆ P`.
* `exists_isClopen_coeff_charFn_zpow_image_mem`: a two-sided ideal containing `1_D` contains every
  translate `1_{T^n(D)} = u^n 1_D u^{-n}`.
* `coeff_mem_of_support_subset_biUnion`: a coefficient supported in a finite union of clopen sets
  with indicators in `J` lies in `J`.  This is the finite clopen subdivision: split off one set of
  the cover at a time.
* `transientIdeal_le_span_compressedDefectSet` (the cover gives `I ⊆ ⟨defects⟩`, coefficient by
  coefficient on the compact supports) and `span_compressedDefectSet_le_transientIdeal` (defects
  avoiding `Y` lie in `I`), so `transientIdeal_eq_span_compressedDefectSet`.
* `disjoint_diff_image_chainRecurrentSet`: `P∖T(P)` misses `CR(T)`, since a chain that starts in `P`
  and is fine enough never leaves `T(P)`.
* Closed endpoint at `Y = CR(T)`: `printedTransientIdealGeneratedByDefects`, using hull-euler's
  cover `Dynamics.compl_chainRecurrentSet_subset`.  Also
  `chainRecurrentSet_eq_univ_of_forall_defectD_eq_zero`.
-/

namespace GroupApproximation
namespace ClopenCrossedProduct

open scoped Uniformity

section Generation

variable {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (T : X ≃ₜ X) (k : Type*) [Ring k]

/-- The compressed-clopen defects `d = 1_{P∖T(P)}` of \eqref{eq:clopen-defect-pair}: `P` clopen
with `T(P) ⊆ P`. -/
def compressedDefectSet : Set (ClopenCrossedProduct T k) :=
  {d | ∃ (P : Set X) (hP : IsClopen P), T '' P ⊆ P ∧ defectD T k hP = d}

theorem charFn_congr_set {U V : Set X} (hU : IsClopen U) (hV : IsClopen V) (h : U = V) :
    LocallyConstant.charFn k hU = LocallyConstant.charFn k hV := by
  subst h
  rfl

/-- `T^(n+1)(D) = T(T^n(D))`. -/
theorem zpow_add_one_image (D : Set X) (n : ℤ) :
    ⇑(T.toEquiv ^ (n + 1)) '' D = T '' (⇑(T.toEquiv ^ n) '' D) := by
  rw [Set.image_image]
  congr 1
  funext y
  rw [add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_one, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Homeomorph.coe_toEquiv]

/-- A two-sided ideal containing the indicator of a clopen `D` contains the indicator of every
translate `T^n(D)`: conjugation by `u` sends `1_V` to `1_{T(V)}`. -/
theorem exists_isClopen_coeff_charFn_zpow_image_mem
    {J : TwoSidedIdeal (ClopenCrossedProduct T k)} {D : Set X} (hD : IsClopen D)
    (hJ : coeff T k (LocallyConstant.charFn k hD) ∈ J) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ h : IsClopen (⇑(T.toEquiv ^ n) '' D), coeff T k (LocallyConstant.charFn k h) ∈ J := by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    have e : ⇑(T.toEquiv ^ (0 : ℤ)) '' D = D := by
      rw [zpow_zero, Equiv.Perm.coe_one, Set.image_id]
    refine ⟨by rw [e]; exact hD, ?_⟩
    rwa [charFn_congr_set k _ hD e]
  | succ i ih =>
    obtain ⟨h, hmem⟩ := ih
    have e := zpow_add_one_image T D (i : ℤ)
    refine ⟨by rw [e]; exact isClopen_image T h, ?_⟩
    rw [charFn_congr_set k _ (isClopen_image T h) e, ← comap_symm_charFn k T h,
      ← unit_mul_coeff_mul_inv T k]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ hmem)
  | pred i ih =>
    obtain ⟨h, hmem⟩ := ih
    have e := zpow_add_one_image T D (-(i : ℤ) - 1)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at e
    have hW : IsClopen (⇑(T.toEquiv ^ (-(i : ℤ) - 1)) '' D) := by
      have h2 := isClopen_image T.symm h
      rw [e, Set.image_image] at h2
      simpa using h2
    refine ⟨hW, ?_⟩
    have key := unit_mul_coeff_mul_inv T k (LocallyConstant.charFn k hW)
    rw [comap_symm_charFn k T hW, charFn_congr_set k _ h e.symm] at key
    have hc : coeff T k (LocallyConstant.charFn k hW) =
        ↑(unit T k)⁻¹ * coeff T k (LocallyConstant.charFn k h) * ↑(unit T k) := by
      have h1 : (↑(unit T k)⁻¹ : ClopenCrossedProduct T k) * ↑(unit T k) = 1 := Units.inv_mul _
      rw [← key, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, h1, mul_one, Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]
    rw [hc]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ hmem)

/-- **The finite clopen subdivision** (tex 1486–1487): a coefficient supported in a finite union
of clopen sets whose indicators lie in `J` lies in `J`. -/
theorem coeff_mem_of_support_subset_biUnion {J : TwoSidedIdeal (ClopenCrossedProduct T k)}
    {ι : Type*} (W : ι → Set X) (hW : ∀ i, IsClopen (W i))
    (hJ : ∀ i, coeff T k (LocallyConstant.charFn k (hW i)) ∈ J) (t : Finset ι) :
    ∀ f : LocallyConstant X k, (∀ x, f x ≠ 0 → x ∈ ⋃ i ∈ t, W i) → coeff T k f ∈ J := by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro f hf
    have hf0 : f = 0 := LocallyConstant.ext fun x ↦ by
      by_contra hx
      simpa using hf x hx
    rw [hf0, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem J
  | insert i t _ ih =>
    intro f hf
    have hsplit : f = f * LocallyConstant.charFn k (hW i) +
        f * (1 - LocallyConstant.charFn k (hW i)) := by
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one]
      abel
    rw [hsplit, map_add, map_mul]
    refine add_mem (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hJ i)) (ih _ fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    have hxi : x ∉ W i := fun hxW ↦ hx (by
      rw [LocallyConstant.mul_apply, LocallyConstant.sub_apply, LocallyConstant.one_apply,
        LocallyConstant.coe_charFn, Set.indicator_of_mem hxW, Pi.one_apply, sub_self, mul_zero])
    have hfx : f x ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hx (by rw [LocallyConstant.mul_apply, h0, zero_mul])
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hf x hfx)
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hj with rfl | hjt
    · exact absurd hxj hxi
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨j, hjt, hxj⟩

/-- **Ideal generation on one coefficient** (tex 1486–1487): a locally constant function vanishing
on `Y` gives a coefficient in the ideal generated by the defects, when the translates of the defects
cover `X ∖ Y`. -/
theorem coeff_mem_span_compressedDefectSet [CompactSpace X] {Y : Set X}
    (hcover : Yᶜ ⊆ ⋃ P ∈ {P : Set X | IsClopen P ∧ T '' P ⊆ P},
      ⋃ n : ℤ, ⇑(T.toEquiv ^ n) '' (P \ T '' P))
    (f : LocallyConstant X k) (hf : ∀ y ∈ Y, f y = 0) :
    coeff T k f ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k) := by
  let ι := {p : Set X × ℤ // IsClopen p.1 ∧ T '' p.1 ⊆ p.1}
  let W : ι → Set X := fun p ↦ ⇑(T.toEquiv ^ p.1.2) '' (p.1.1 \ T '' p.1.1)
  have htrans : ∀ p : ι, ∃ h : IsClopen (W p),
      coeff T k (LocallyConstant.charFn k h) ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k) :=
    fun p ↦ exists_isClopen_coeff_charFn_zpow_image_mem T k
      (J := TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k)) (p.2.1.diff (isClopen_image T p.2.1))
      (TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨p.1.1, p.2.1, p.2.2, rfl⟩) p.1.2
  have hS : IsCompact {x | f x ≠ 0} :=
    (f.isLocallyConstant.isClopen_fiber 0).compl.isClosed.isCompact
  have hcov : {x | f x ≠ 0} ⊆ ⋃ p : ι, W p := by
    intro x hx
    have hxY : x ∈ Yᶜ := fun hxY ↦ hx (hf x hxY)
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcover hxY)
    obtain ⟨n, hxn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxP
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨(P, n), hP⟩, hxn⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hS.elim_finite_subcover W (fun p ↦ (htrans p).1.isOpen) hcov
  exact coeff_mem_of_support_subset_biUnion T k W (fun p ↦ (htrans p).1) (fun p ↦ (htrans p).2) t
    f fun x hx ↦ ht hx

/-- **`I ⊆ ⟨defects⟩`** (tex 1484–1487): write `x ∈ I` in Laurent form; every coefficient vanishes
on `Y` and so lies in the ideal generated by the defects. -/
theorem transientIdeal_le_span_compressedDefectSet [CompactSpace X] {Y : Set X} (hY : T '' Y = Y)
    (hcover : Yᶜ ⊆ ⋃ P ∈ {P : Set X | IsClopen P ∧ T '' P ⊆ P},
      ⋃ n : ℤ, ⇑(T.toEquiv ^ n) '' (P \ T '' P)) :
    transientIdeal T k hY ≤ TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k) := by
  intro x hx
  have hcoeff := (mem_transientIdeal_iff_forall_coeff T k hY).1 hx
  have hx_eq : x = ∑ g ∈ x.support, SkewMonoidAlgebra.single g (x.coeff g) :=
    (SkewMonoidAlgebra.sum_single x).symm.trans (SkewMonoidAlgebra.sum_def' _ _)
  have hsum : ∑ g ∈ x.support, SkewMonoidAlgebra.single g (x.coeff g) ∈
      TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k) := by
    refine TwoSidedIdeal.finsetSum_mem _ _ fun g _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Pestov91.CrossedProduct.single_eq_C_mul]
    refine TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_
    have hc : Pestov91.CrossedProduct.C (x.coeff g) =
        coeff T k ((ClopenCoeff.of T k).symm (x.coeff g)) := by
      rw [coeff_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [hc]
    exact coeff_mem_span_compressedDefectSet T k hcover _ fun y hy ↦ hcoeff g y hy
  rwa [← hx_eq] at hsum

/-- A defect whose set `P∖T(P)` misses `Y` lies in `I`. -/
theorem defectD_mem_transientIdeal {Y : Set X} (hY : T '' Y = Y) {P : Set X} (hP : IsClopen P)
    (havoid : Disjoint (P \ T '' P) Y) : defectD T k hP ∈ transientIdeal T k hY := by
  rw [mem_transientIdeal, defectD, restrict_coeff]
  have h0 : LocallyConstant.comap (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(Y, X))
      (LocallyConstant.charFn k (hP.diff (isClopen_image T hP))) = 0 :=
    LocallyConstant.ext fun y ↦
      Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h ↦ Set.disjoint_left.1 havoid h y.2) _
  rw [h0, map_zero]

/-- **`⟨defects⟩ ⊆ I`**, when every defect set misses `Y`. -/
theorem span_compressedDefectSet_le_transientIdeal {Y : Set X} (hY : T '' Y = Y)
    (havoid : ∀ P : Set X, IsClopen P → T '' P ⊆ P → Disjoint (P \ T '' P) Y) :
    TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k) ≤ transientIdeal T k hY := by
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨P, hP, hTP, rfl⟩
  exact defectD_mem_transientIdeal T k hY hP (havoid P hP hTP)

/-- **`I` is generated by the defects** (tex 1476–1487), for an invariant `Y` whose complement is
covered by the translates of the defect sets, each of which misses `Y`. -/
theorem transientIdeal_eq_span_compressedDefectSet [CompactSpace X] {Y : Set X} (hY : T '' Y = Y)
    (hcover : Yᶜ ⊆ ⋃ P ∈ {P : Set X | IsClopen P ∧ T '' P ⊆ P},
      ⋃ n : ℤ, ⇑(T.toEquiv ^ n) '' (P \ T '' P))
    (havoid : ∀ P : Set X, IsClopen P → T '' P ⊆ P → Disjoint (P \ T '' P) Y) :
    transientIdeal T k hY = TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k) :=
  le_antisymm (transientIdeal_le_span_compressedDefectSet T k hY hcover)
    (span_compressedDefectSet_le_transientIdeal T k hY havoid)

end Generation

section Core

variable {X : Type*} [UniformSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (T : X ≃ₜ X)

/-- **The defect sets miss the chain-recurrent set**: a chain from `x ∈ P` whose steps respect the
clopen partition `{T(P), X ∖ T(P)}` stays in `T(P)`, so it never returns to `x ∉ T(P)`. -/
theorem disjoint_diff_image_chainRecurrentSet {P : Set X} (hP : IsClopen P) (hTP : T '' P ⊆ P) :
    Disjoint (P \ T '' P) (Dynamics.chainRecurrentSet T) := by
  have hQ : IsClopen (T '' P) := isClopen_image T hP
  have hE : (T '' P) ×ˢ (T '' P) ∪ (T '' P)ᶜ ×ˢ (T '' P)ᶜ ∈ 𝓤 X := by
    rw [← nhdsSet_diagonal_eq_uniformity]
    refine ((hQ.isOpen.prod hQ.isOpen).union
      (hQ.compl.isOpen.prod hQ.compl.isOpen)).mem_nhdsSet.2 ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩ (hab : a = b)
    subst hab
    by_cases ha : a ∈ T '' P
    · exact Or.inl ⟨ha, ha⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨ha, ha⟩
  have step : ∀ {a b : X},
      Dynamics.ChainStep T ((T '' P) ×ˢ (T '' P) ∪ (T '' P)ᶜ ×ˢ (T '' P)ᶜ) a b →
        T a ∈ T '' P → b ∈ T '' P := by
    intro a b hab ha
    have hab' : (T a, b) ∈ (T '' P) ×ˢ (T '' P) ∪ (T '' P)ᶜ ×ˢ (T '' P)ᶜ := hab
    rcases hab' with ⟨-, hb⟩ | ⟨ha', -⟩
    · exact hb
    · exact absurd ha ha'
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro x ⟨hxP, hxTP⟩ hx
  have key : ∀ {b : X},
      Relation.TransGen
        (Dynamics.ChainStep T ((T '' P) ×ˢ (T '' P) ∪ (T '' P)ᶜ ×ˢ (T '' P)ᶜ)) x b →
        b ∈ T '' P := by
    intro b hb
    induction hb with
    | single hxb => exact step hxb (Set.mem_image_of_mem T hxP)
    | tail _ hbc ih => exact step hbc (Set.mem_image_of_mem T (hTP ih))
  exact hxTP (key (hx _ hE))

/-- **`I` is generated by the defects at `Y = CR(T)`** (tex 1476–1487). -/
theorem transientIdeal_chainRecurrentSet_eq_span [T2Space X] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace X]
    (k : Type*) [Ring k] :
    transientIdeal T k (Dynamics.image_chainRecurrentSet T) =
      TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k) :=
  transientIdeal_eq_span_compressedDefectSet T k _ (Dynamics.compl_chainRecurrentSet_subset T)
    fun _ hP hTP ↦ disjoint_diff_image_chainRecurrentSet T hP hTP

/-- If every defect vanishes, every point is chain recurrent (`I = 0` exactly when `X = Y`). -/
theorem chainRecurrentSet_eq_univ_of_forall_defectD_eq_zero [T2Space X]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace X] (k : Type*) [Ring k] [Nontrivial k]
    (h : ∀ (P : Set X) (hP : IsClopen P), T '' P ⊆ P → defectD T k hP = 0) :
    Dynamics.chainRecurrentSet T = Set.univ := by
  rw [← transientIdeal_eq_bot_iff T k (Dynamics.isClosed_chainRecurrentSet T.continuous)
    (Dynamics.image_chainRecurrentSet T), transientIdeal_chainRecurrentSet_eq_span T k,
    eq_bot_iff, TwoSidedIdeal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨P, hP, hTP, rfl⟩
  rw [h P hP hTP]
  exact zero_mem _

end Core

/-- **tex 1476–1487**, "The ideal $I$ is [...] generated by the indicators $1_{P\setminus T(P)}$ of
the defects": for a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected `X`, a homeomorphism `T` and a ring `k`,
the kernel of restriction to `CR(T)` is the two-sided ideal generated by the compressed-clopen
defects. -/
def PrintedTransientIdealGeneratedByDefects : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : Type) [UniformSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace X]
    (T : X ≃ₜ X) (k : Type) [Ring k],
    transientIdeal T k (Dynamics.image_chainRecurrentSet T) =
      TwoSidedIdeal.span (compressedDefectSet T k)

theorem printedTransientIdealGeneratedByDefects : PrintedTransientIdealGeneratedByDefects :=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ T k _ ↦ transientIdeal_chainRecurrentSet_eq_span T k

end ClopenCrossedProduct
end GroupApproximation

open GroupApproximation

#audit_closed_axioms GroupApproximation.ClopenCrossedProduct.printedTransientIdealGeneratedByDefects
#audit_axioms GroupApproximation.ClopenCrossedProduct.transientIdeal_eq_span_compressedDefectSet
#audit_axioms GroupApproximation.ClopenCrossedProduct.disjoint_diff_image_chainRecurrentSet
#audit_axioms GroupApproximation.ClopenCrossedProduct.chainRecurrentSet_eq_univ_of_forall_defectD_eq_zero
